_comment: Editable context-window table, read by agents/shared/model_windows.py and
managed from the Workflow Settings > Model context windows panel.
Keys are MODEL-NAME PREFIXES, matched LONGEST-FIRST — so a specific
version always wins over a shorter family key.  That is required, not
cosmetic: Claude Opus 4.5 is 200k while Opus 4.6+ is 1M, and Sonnet 4.5 is
200k while Sonnet 4.6+ is 1M, so any family-level key alone would be wrong
for half the family.  The short family entries at the bottom are therefore
'default' applies to a model matching nothing — deliberately the smallest
window in use, so an unrecognised model prunes early rather than
Values are max INPUT tokens (the context window), not max output.
Anthropic models are refreshed live from GET /v1/models at startup, which
overrides anything here; OpenAI's models endpoint does not expose a window,
so OpenAI entries must be maintained here by hand.
Verified against provider documentation, July 2026.  If this file is
missing or malformed the module falls back to its built-in table, so a bad
edit degrades rather than breaking startup.
